name: After recital E
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text: Ea. whereas both sides report significant foreign mercenary involvement, with Russia estimating around 20 000 supporting Ukraine and Ukraine estimating 18 000 for Russia; whereas they tap into existing migrant labour networks to lure them with false job promises and send them to the front line;
